title: AI becoming Florida’s next political flash point
description: Our political analyst Dr. Susan MacManus joins us to talk about the AI push back. So is this becoming Florida’s next defining political issue? And what could it mean for the Governor’s race.

title: China Bans AI Chatbots from Forming Emotional Bonds with Minors in Demographic Crackdown
description: China's Cyberspace Administration has implemented new rules prohibiting AI companion chatbots from encouraging emotional dependence or forming virtual relationships with minors. The regulations, part of a broader demographic strategy, require AI to remind users they are not human and mandate guardians be contacted during crises. The crackdown follows concerns about chatbots removing people from the marriage market as China's birthrate hits record lows.

title: Norfolk Village Battles Proposed AI Data Centre to Preserve Rural Landscape
description: A proposed massive data centre in rural Norfolk has sparked a local uprising, with residents-including BBC's Jake Humphrey-fighting to protect their countryside from industrialisation tied to the UK's AI ambitions.

title: Next-Generation Memory Market to Reach USD 17.7 Billion by 2028 Amid Rising AI and Cloud Adoption
description: The next-generation memory industry size is projected to grow from USD 6.2 billion in 2023 to reach USD 17.7 billion by 2028; it is expected to grow at a Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of 23.2% from 2023 to 2028. The growth of the next-generation memory industry is driven by growing adoption of next-generation memory solutions in automotive sector to handle evolving data and computational needs, and suring adoption of next-generation memories in smartphones and smart wearables.
